Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_device_info.description:
Identify the oscilloscope (model, serial, firmware), the command family used for it, the
number of analog channels, and the current sample rate and memory depth.

get_settings.description:
Read the current vertical settings of every channel (on/off, V/div, offset, coupling, probe
ratio, bandwidth limit), the timebase, the trigger (type, sweep, status, edge source/level/slope)
and the acquisition sample rate / memory depth.

measure.description:
Read the scope's automatic measurements for one channel: voltages (Vpp, Vmax, Vmin, Vtop,
Vbase, Vamp, Vavg, Vrms, overshoot, preshoot) and timing (period, frequency, rise/fall time,
+/- width, +/- duty). Values the scope cannot determine are null.

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

screenshot.description:
Save a screenshot of the oscilloscope display (PNG; BMP on the MSO5000) and return its path.
For PNG screenshots the image is also returned so the model can look at the screen.

include_image.description: Also return the image to the client (PNG only)

save_path.description: New image file to write (.png; .bmp on the MSO5000; never overwritten); default: a timestamped file in the system temp folder

set_channel.description:
Change a channel's vertical settings; unspecified settings are left alone. The probe ratio
is applied first because it changes the valid scale range. Returns the settings the scope
actually applied (the scale snaps to 1-2-5 steps). Rejected values are reported from the
scope's error queue.

probe_ratio.description: Probe attenuation, e.g. 1 or 10 - must match the probe

set_timebase.description: Set the main timebase scale and/or offset. Returns the applied values.

set_trigger.description:
Configure an edge trigger (source, level, slope) and the sweep mode. Sets the trigger type to
EDGE. The level must lie within the source channel's screen range.

sweep.description: auto = free-run when not triggered; normal = only on trigger; single = once

single.description:
Arm a single acquisition (SINGLE key): the scope triggers once, then stops. With wait_s > 0
it waits until the acquisition is complete (status STOP). If the trigger condition is never met
the status stays WAIT - check the trigger level/source or use `force_trigger`.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the trigger; 0 = just arm

stop.description: Stop acquisition (STOP) and freeze the current waveforms, e.g. before reading deep memory.

Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

lock_keypad.description: Block or unblock the balance keys, e.g. so nobody tares by accident during a long logging run.

locked.description: True blocks the balance keys (ESC O), False unblocks (ESC R)

log_weight_series.description:
Record a series of immediate (unfiltered) readings to monitor drift, evaporation,
moisture uptake or stabilisation. Returns every reading plus summary statistics.

read_weight.description:
Read the current net weight from the balance (ESC P). With stable=True the server polls
until the balance reports a stable value; if it cannot settle (draughts, vibration,
evaporation) you get an error; retry, or use stable=false for the current value.

timeout_s.description: Max. seconds to wait for stability

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

run_internal_adjustment.description:
Adjust (calibrate) the balance with its built-in weight (ESC Z; isoCAL models only).
The pan must be empty and the balance undisturbed. SBI sends no completion message, so the
server watches for the adjustment status and waits until the balance weighs again; check
`observed_adjustment` and the balance display or GLP printout for the result.

timeout_s.description: Max. seconds for the adjustment

set_ambient_conditions.description:
Adapt the balance's filter to the ambient conditions (ESC K/L/M/N). Use 'unstable' or
'very_unstable' for draughty or vibrating benches (slower but steadier readings).

timeout_s.description: Max. seconds to wait for the tared reading

zero.description:
Zero the balance (ESC V). Only works with the pan (nearly) empty, within the balance's
zero-setting range; clears the tare. Confirms by reading ~0 afterwards.

timeout_s.description: Max. seconds to wait for the zeroed reading

max_block_bytes.description: Largest binary block the server will read

max_operation_wait_s.description: Longest *OPC? wait an agent may request

apply_safe_state.description:
Put the instrument into the lab's configured safe state (the `--option safe_state`
program message, e.g. 'OUTP OFF'), then read the error queue. Only listed when a safe
state is configured. Call it immediately if anything looks wrong.

device_clear.description:
Recover a stuck or confused instrument: VISA device clear (or discard unread input on
socket/serial links), report the error queue, optionally ABORt, then *CLS. This does NOT
make an arbitrary instrument safe (outputs stay as they are): use `apply_safe_state` if
the lab configured one, or the instrument's own controls.

get_command_log.description:
Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_errors.description:
Read and clear the instrument's error/event queue (SYSTem:ERRor? until 0,"No error").
Entries are returned oldest first; each can only be read once. An empty list means no
errors.

identify.description: Ask the instrument who it is (*IDN?): manufacturer, model, serial number, firmware.

list_visa_resources.description:
List GPIB / USBTMC / LAN (VXI-11, HiSLIP) instruments visible to VISA on this computer.
Works without --address. Raw-socket instruments (tcp://host:5025) are not discoverable.

query_binary_block.description:
Read an IEEE 488.2 definite-length binary block (waveforms, trace data, screenshots,
FORMat REAL/INTeger readings). The query must pass the same read-only checks as
`scpi_query`. Returns length, SHA-256 and (optionally) decoded values with summary
statistics, downsampled to max_points; use save_path for the full data. Blocks larger
than the `max_block_bytes` limit are discarded.

byte_order.description: big = SCPI FORMat:BORDer NORMal, little = SWAPped

decode_as.description: Interpret the payload as an array of this type (see the instrument's FORMat)

max_inline_bytes.description: Return the raw payload as base64 only up to this size

max_points.description: Max decoded values returned inline

save_path.description: Write the full data here: .csv with decode_as writes index,value rows; .bin/.dat/.raw/.txt/.png/.bmp/.jpg/.gif/.tif (or .csv with decode_as none) get the raw payload

timeout_s.description: Timeout for the whole transfer

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

reset_instrument.description:
Reset the instrument to its default settings (*RST, then *CLS), wait for completion and
check errors. SCPI requires outputs OFF after *RST, but every other setting (levels,
ranges, triggers, limits) returns to its default and some instruments differ: check the
manual before resetting anything connected to a device under test.

clear_status.description: Also send *CLS (clear status and error queue)

scpi_batch.description:
Run a short sequence of SCPI commands and queries in order, checking the error queue
after every step. Every step is checked against the command policy BEFORE the first one
is sent, so a refused step means nothing was sent. Returns per-step replies and errors.
Steps not started within ~14 minutes are not sent (status not_run).

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first step that reports an error

timeout_s.description: Reply timeout per query

scpi_primer.description:
Concise SCPI syntax guide (long/short forms, queries, compound commands, common
commands, error queue, binary blocks) plus this server's active command policy. Works
without a connection.

scpi_query.description:
Send ONE read-only SCPI query and return the instrument's text reply.

Only single queries are accepted: the header must end with '?' (parameters such as
'VOLT? MAX' are allowed), with no ';' and no line breaks. Queries with known side
effects (*TST?, *CAL?, CALibration, DIAGnostic) and anything in the lab's query
denylist are refused - use `scpi_write` for those. An unknown query gets no reply
(timeout); the error queue is then reported.

timeout_s.description: Reply timeout (default: server's)

scpi_write.description:
Send any SCPI program message (settings, compound 'A;B' messages, queries with side
effects) and then read the error queue. If the message contains a query, its reply is
returned. This can change the instrument's state, including switching outputs on;
say what the command does before calling it. Commands in the lab's denylist, or
outside its allowlist, are refused before anything is sent.

command.description: SCPI program message, e.g. 'VOLT 5;CURR 0.1' or 'OUTP ON'

timeout_s.description: Reply timeout if it contains a query

wait_operation_complete.description:
Wait until the instrument has finished all pending operations (*OPC? returns 1),
e.g. after starting a sweep, an acquisition or a settling source.

timeout_s.description: Longest time to wait

max_command_wait_s.description: Longest call_command wait for an observable command

call_command.description:
Run a SiLA command. This may physically act on the device (move, dispense, heat, shake, open
doors): tell the user what will happen first. Parameters are validated against the Feature
Definition before anything is sent, and the command must be in the allow-list if one is set.
Unobservable commands return their responses; observable ones return an `execution_id`.

metadata.description: SiLA client metadata, e.g. {'LockController.LockIdentifier': '...'} (if the server requires it)

parameters.description: Parameter identifier -> value, as described by list_features

wait_s.description: Observable commands: wait up to this long for completion (0 = return at once)

cancel_command.description:
Cancel a running observable command, or all commands, through SiLA's CancelController feature.
Always available (even read-only). If the server has no CancelController, this explains that and
points to the device's own stop command.

all_commands.description: Cancel every running command on the server

execution_id.description: Execution to cancel; omit (or all_commands=true) to cancel everything

discover_servers.description:
Find SiLA 2 servers on the local network with SiLA Server Discovery (mDNS `_sila._tcp`). Lists
name, UUID, address and port of each without connecting. Does not need a configured server.

timeout_s.description: How long to listen for mDNS announcements

Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_command_result.description:
Responses of a finished observable command, or the SiLA execution error it finished with.
Fails with a clear message if the command is still running.

get_command_status.description:
Status of an observable command started with `call_command`: waiting / running /
finishedSuccessfully / finishedWithError, progress, estimated remaining time and the latest
intermediate response.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_property.description:
Read the current value of a SiLA property (for observable properties: the first value of a
subscription).

metadata.description: SiLA client metadata, e.g. {'LockController.LockIdentifier': '...'} (if the server requires it)

get_server_info.description:
Identify the connected SiLA server (name, type, UUID, version, vendor, description), list its
features, and say whether commands can be cancelled and which commands this bridge may call.

list_executions.description: All observable command executions started in this session, newest last, with their status.

list_features.description:
Describe the server's features from their Feature Definitions: every command (observable or
not, parameters, responses, intermediate responses, defined errors, and whether the allow-list
permits calling it) and every property, with types rendered as JSON-schema-like dicts including
units and constraints.

include_fdl.description: Also return the raw Feature Definition XML

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

subscribe_property.description:
Collect a property's values for `duration_s` seconds (SiLA subscription for observable
properties, polling otherwise) and summarise them (e.g. watch a temperature settle).

metadata.description: SiLA client metadata, e.g. {'LockController.LockIdentifier': '...'} (if the server requires it)

max_amplitude_v.description: Largest sine-output amplitude (V rms) an agent may set

max_sweep_duration_s.description: Longest frequency sweep an agent may start

auto_gain.description:
Pick the sensitivity automatically for the present signal (SR830 AGAN / SR86x ASCL).
On the SR830 AGAN does nothing when the time constant is longer than 1 s.

auto_phase.description:
Run Auto Phase (APHS): shift the reference phase so that Y ≈ 0 and X ≈ R. The outputs then
need several time constants to settle. Does nothing if the phase is unstable.

auto_range.description:
Optimise the input stage for the present signal: SR830 Auto Reserve (ARSV) or SR86x
Auto Range of the voltage input range (ARNG).

frequency_sweep.description:
Step the internal reference (and SINE OUT drive) from start_hz to stop_hz, waiting for the
output filter to settle at each point, and record X/Y/R/θ vs frequency - e.g. a resonance or
transfer-function measurement. The drive amplitude stays at its present value. Needs the
internal reference. The estimated duration must be within `max_sweep_duration_s`;
`set_amplitude_minimum` stops a running sweep. `save_path` must be a new .csv file.

restore_frequency.description: Return to the starting frequency afterwards

save_path.description: Optional CSV file for the full sweep

settle_time_constants.description: Wait per point in time constants (default: 99 % settling for the slope)

get_command_log.description:
Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_settings.description:
Report the reference (source, frequency, harmonic, phase), sine output, sensitivity,
time constant/slope (with the 99 % settling time), and input configuration.

read_outputs.description:
Read X, Y, R and θ as one coherent snapshot (SNAP?), with the reference frequency,
sensitivity, fraction of full scale and any overloads latched since the last reading.

Values are only meaningful once the output filter has settled (~5-10 time constants after a
change).

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

set_amplitude.description:
Set the SINE OUT amplitude (V rms), which drives the sample or excitation circuit.
Refused above the `max_amplitude_v` safety limit. Tell the user the new drive level first.

amplitude_v.description: Sine output amplitude in V rms

set_amplitude_minimum.description:
Turn the sine output down to the instrument minimum (the lock-in's closest thing to
'output off') and stop any running frequency sweep. SR810/SR830: 4 mV rms (it cannot go to
zero - disconnect the cable if the sample must see no drive). SR86x: 1 nV rms and DC level 0 V.

set_input.description:
Configure the signal input: A / A-B / current, AC or DC coupling, shield float/ground and
(SR86x) the voltage input range. Use DC coupling below ~160 mHz. Omitted parameters are left
unchanged.

configuration.description: Single-ended A, differential A-B, or current input with 1 MΩ / 100 MΩ gain

set_reference.description:
Set the reference: source (internal/external), internal frequency, detection harmonic and
phase shift. Omitted parameters are left unchanged. Changing the frequency also changes the
frequency of the SINE OUT drive (at the current amplitude).

source.description: internal = sine output oscillator; external = lock to REF IN

set_sensitivity.description:
Set the sensitivity (full-scale range). The smallest available range that is at least
`full_scale` is chosen, so a signal of that size does not overload. On SR810/SR830 the dynamic
reserve can be set at the same time.

full_scale.description: Largest signal to measure without overload

unit.description: V for voltage inputs; A for current inputs (1 V <-> 1 µA)

set_time_constant.description:
Set the output filter time constant (nearest available value), and optionally the filter
slope and synchronous filter. The SR830 may raise a too-short time constant to its minimum for
the current slope/reserve; the returned settings show the value actually used.

max_cdem_pressure_torr.description: Highest pressure at which the CDEM may be switched on

max_cdem_voltage_v.description: Highest CDEM high voltage an agent may set

max_degas_minutes.description: Longest ionizer degas an agent may start

max_filament_pressure_torr.description: Highest pressure at which the filament may be switched on or the ionizer degassed

max_pressure_reading_age_s.description: Oldest RGA total-pressure reading accepted as evidence (only while the filament stays on)

all_off.description:
Put the RGA in a safe state: abort any degas, CDEM off (HV0), filament off (FL0)
and quadrupole RF/DC off (MR0). Use when finished, before venting, or if anything looks wrong.
It interrupts a running scan or leak check, and every step is attempted even if an earlier
one fails.

analog_scan.description:
Record an analog mass spectrum (SC1): the quadrupole steps through the mass range and the
full peak shapes are returned (downsampled) with a peak list, the total pressure measured at
the end of the scan, and optionally the full data as CSV. Use it to check peak positions and
to survey unknown gases. Duration depends on the noise floor (e.g. 126 ms/amu at NF4). An
existing save_path file is never overwritten.

max_points.description: Spectrum points returned

save_path.description: Optional CSV path for the full spectrum (must not exist yet)

calibrate.description:
Calibrate the detector: `zero` (CA) re-zeroes the ion detector at the present noise floor
and detector and corrects the RF scan table for temperature drift (seconds); `electrometer`
(CL) recalibrates the electrometer's full I-V response (longer, clears all zero offsets). The
quadrupole RF is switched off at the end.

kind.description: zero = CA (re-zero detector + mass axis correction); electrometer = CL (full I-V)

cdem_off.description:
Switch the electron multiplier off (HV0) and return to Faraday-cup detection. Always
allowed, and it interrupts a running scan, mass measurement or leak check.

degas.description:
Start an ionizer degas (DG): 20 mA of 400 eV electrons clean the ion source by electron
stimulated desorption. The CDEM is switched off and left off. Degassing shortens filament
life; prefer a bakeout. Refused above `max_filament_pressure_torr` and beyond
`max_degas_minutes`. Returns immediately; the RGA is busy until it finishes (any command would
abort it), and `filament_off` / `all_off` stop it.

external_pressure_torr.description: Pressure just read on a separate vacuum gauge, confirmed by the user

filament_off.description:
Switch the filament off (FL0), stopping a degas first if one is running. Always allowed,
and it interrupts a running scan, mass measurement or leak check.

get_command_log.description:
Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_status.description:
Report the RGA state: filament emission, CDEM on/off and voltage, ionizer settings, scan
settings, stored sensitivity factors, and the decoded error bytes (e.g. FL6 when the
overpressure protection shut the filament down). Reading the error bytes clears the
communication (EC?) and CDEM (EM?) error bytes, as on the instrument.

histogram_scan.description:
Record a bar-graph spectrum (HS1): one peak-locked value per integer m/z plus the total
pressure. Faster than an analog scan and the usual way to follow a residual gas composition.

save_path.description: Optional CSV path (must not exist yet)

identify_residual_gases.description:
Run a histogram scan and assign the major peaks to likely gases with a simple lookup of
standard 70 eV fragment patterns: H2 (2), He (4), CH4 (16/15), H2O (18/17), N2 or CO (28,
split with 14 and 12), O2 (32), Ar (40), CO2 (44), plus diagnoses such as an air leak or
hydrocarbon contamination. A screening aid, not a quantitative analysis.

stop_mass.description: Scan m/z 1 up to this mass

leak_check.description:
Helium leak check: monitor m/z 4 while someone sprays helium on suspect joints, and report
the baseline, every response above `threshold_factor` x baseline (start/end time, peak) and
the time series. Keep the first few seconds free of helium so the baseline is clean. The
response time of a real leak is a few seconds. Bounded by `max_leak_check_duration_s`.

max_points.description: Points returned

save_path.description: Optional CSV file for every reading (must not exist yet)

threshold_factor.description: Signal/baseline ratio that counts as a leak response

measure_masses.description:
Measure partial pressures at a list of m/z values (peak-locked single-mass measurements,
MR). Fast and precise for monitoring known gases; the precision and time per mass are set by
the noise floor (`set_scan_parameters`). Pressures are N2-equivalent.

read_total_pressure.description:
Measure the total pressure with the RGA acting as an ionisation gauge (TP?, Faraday cup).
Needs the filament on and the CDEM off. The value is N2-equivalent and can differ from a
Bayard-Alpert gauge by a factor of a few, depending on the gas composition.

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

set_cdem.description:
Switch the electron multiplier (CDEM) on at a given high voltage for ~100-10000x more
signal. High pressure shortens CDEM life and can destroy it, so this is refused unless the
pressure is below `max_cdem_pressure_torr` (RGA total pressure measured now with the Faraday
cup, a recent one, or `external_pressure_torr`), and the voltage is capped by
`max_cdem_voltage_v`. Total-pressure readings are disabled while the CDEM is on.

external_pressure_torr.description: Pressure just read on a separate vacuum gauge, confirmed by the user

voltage_v.description: CDEM high voltage (magnitude); typical 1000-1600 V, default 1400

set_filament.description:
Switch the filament on (or change its emission current). The filament burns out or is
damaged above 1e-4 Torr, so this is refused unless the pressure is below
`max_filament_pressure_torr`: pass `external_pressure_torr` from a separate gauge, or, if the
filament is already on, the RGA's own total pressure is measured. The RGA's protection will
also shut the filament down on overpressure (reported as FL6).

emission_current_ma.description: Electron emission current; 1.0 mA is the standard setting

external_pressure_torr.description: Pressure just read on a separate vacuum gauge, confirmed by the user

set_scan_parameters.description:
Change measurement settings: noise floor (speed vs detection limit), electron energy, ion
energy, focus plate voltage and analog-scan resolution. Sensitivity factors stored in the head
are only valid at the default ionizer settings (70 eV, 12 eV, 90 V). After changing the noise
floor the detector zero is re-adjusted automatically at the start of the next scan.

max_acquisition_duration_s.description: Longest acquisition an agent may start (other modes are stopped after it)

max_custom_scans_per_minute.description: Custom scans an agent may place per minute

max_injection_time_ms.description: Largest maximum injection time (MaxIT) in a scan

cancel_custom_scans.description: Cancel any pending custom scan and its processing delay (IAPI CancelCustomScan).

cancel_repeating_scan.description: Cancel the repeating scan set with set_repeating_scan (IAPI CancelRepetition).

get_command_log.description:
Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_instrument_status.description:
Report the instrument model, IAPI service/instrument connection, system mode and state
(On/Standby/Off; Running/ReadyToDownload/...), whether an acquisition can be paused or
resumed, the IAPI licence where the API exposes it, requested readbacks, the latest scan
status log (vacuum, source) and how many scans have arrived.

get_possible_scan_parameters.description:
List the scan parameters this instrument accepts for custom and repeating scans
(IScans.PossibleParameters): name, allowed range or choices, default and help. The set
depends on the model, licence and Tune version.

refresh.description: Re-read from the instrument instead of the cache

get_recent_scans.description:
Return the most recent scans received from the instrument (oldest first), optionally
only one MS order or one custom scan's access id: scan number, MS order, precursor m/z,
AGC target, injection time and the most intense centroids. Scans only arrive in On mode.

access_id.description: Only scans with this access id (-1 = system scans)

count.description: Number of most recent matching scans

include_header_trailer.description: Include the raw header and trailer

max_centroids.description: Most intense centroids to return per scan

ms_order.description: Only scans of this MS order (1 = MS1)

save_path.description: Optional .csv path (must not exist yet): write all kept centroids of the returned scans

pause_acquisition.description: Pause the running acquisition (IAPI Pause). Fails if the instrument reports it cannot pause.

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

resume_acquisition.description: Resume a paused acquisition (IAPI Resume). Sample consumption continues.

set_repeating_scan.description:
Define or replace the scan the instrument repeats when no method or custom scan is
running (IAPI CreateRepeatingScan/SetRepetitionScan). Values are validated like
submit_custom_scan. Cancel with cancel_repeating_scan.

analyzer.description: Mass analyzer, e.g. Orbitrap or IonTrap (Tribrid)

extra_parameters.description: Other IAPI scan values by exact name (see get_possible_scan_parameters)

orbitrap_resolution.description: OrbitrapResolution at m/z 200; must be an allowed value

polarity.description: Polarity as the instrument lists it

scan_type.description: ScanType, e.g. Full, SIM or MSn

start_acquisition.description:
Start an acquisition with the instrument's current settings (IAPI StartAcquisition),
recording to a raw file. This consumes sample. The instrument must be On; an acquisition
must not already be running. Stop it with stop_acquisition. scan_count and until_stopped
acquisitions are cancelled automatically after max_acquisition_duration_s.

mode.description: Stop after duration_s, after scan_count scans, or only when stopped

raw_file_path.description: Raw file to write on the instrument PC, e.g. D:\Data\run1.raw

stop_acquisition.description:
Stop the running acquisition (IAPI CancelAcquisition), by default also cancelling custom
and repeating scans, and optionally switch the instrument to Standby (switch back to On in
Tune). Every step is attempted even if an earlier one fails; failures are reported.

cancel_scans.description: Also cancel pending custom scans and the repeating scan

standby.description: Then put the instrument in Standby

submit_custom_scan.description:
Place one custom scan to run next (IAPI CreateCustomScan/SetCustomScan); unset values
fall back to the instrument's defaults. Every value is checked against
PossibleParameters and the safety limits, and calls are rate-limited, before anything is
sent. Fetch the result with wait_for_scan(access_id=running_number).

analyzer.description: Mass analyzer, e.g. Orbitrap or IonTrap (Tribrid)

extra_parameters.description: Other IAPI scan values by exact name (see get_possible_scan_parameters)

orbitrap_resolution.description: OrbitrapResolution at m/z 200; must be an allowed value

polarity.description: Polarity as the instrument lists it

scan_type.description: ScanType, e.g. Full, SIM or MSn

single_processing_delay_s.description: Hold further custom scans this long (ICustomScan.SingleProcessingDelay)

wait_for_scan.description:
Wait for the next scan that arrives after this call (optionally of one MS order, or the
result of a custom scan by its access id) and return it. For a custom scan placed with
submit_custom_scan, a result that arrived since it was placed is returned at once. Returns
found=false after timeout_s if nothing matching arrived (e.g. the instrument is in Standby).

access_id.description: Only scans with this access id (-1 = system scans)

include_header_trailer.description: Include the raw header and trailer

max_centroids.description: Most intense centroids to return per scan

ms_order.description: Only scans of this MS order (1 = MS1)

timeout_s.description: Longest time to wait

get_command_log.description:
Return the most recent raw commands sent to / replies received from the
instrument (newest last). Useful for debugging and for recording what was done.

get_connection_info.description:
Report which instrument is connected (identity, address, simulated or real),
whether the server is read-only, and the active safety limits. Call this first.

get_device_info.description:
Identify the meter console and the attached sensor head (model, serial, type, wavelength
range, power ranges), and report the present wavelength, averaging, range and zero value.

log_power_series.description:
Log a series of power readings to characterise laser stability, warm-up or drift. Returns
mean, stdev, min/max, RMS and peak-to-peak stability (%) and drift (%/min), plus the readings
(downsampled to `max_points`; use `save_path`, a new .csv file, to keep all of them).

interval_s.description: Seconds between readings (0 = as fast as the meter allows)

max_points.description: Maximum readings returned in the reply

save_path.description: Optional CSV path for every reading

read_power.description:
Read the optical power once (in W, plus dBm and a formatted string). The reading uses the
configured correction wavelength and averaging; set the wavelength first.

read_sensor_temperature.description:
Read the sensor head temperature in °C (thermal sensors and other heads with a built-in
temperature sensor only).

reconnect.description:
Close and re-open the connection to the instrument (e.g. after it was power
cycled or a cable was re-plugged).

set_averaging.description:
Set how many samples the meter averages for each reading. More averaging lowers noise but
slows each reading (PM100 series: ~3 ms per sample; PM400/PM101/PM5020: 1 ms).

count.description: Samples averaged per reading (PM100: ~3 ms per sample)

set_range.description:
Select auto-ranging, or a fixed power range that fits `range_w` (the meter picks the most
sensitive range that can hold that power). A fixed range reports over-range if exceeded.

range_w.description: For manual mode: the highest power you expect, in W

set_wavelength.description:
Set the correction wavelength (nm) the meter uses to convert sensor signal to power. Must be
within the sensor's calibrated range (see `get_device_info`); sent as a whole number of nm.

zero_sensor.description:
Dark-zero the sensor (removes dark current / thermal offset). BEFORE calling, ask the user
to block the beam and cover the sensor aperture completely, and wait for them to confirm:
zeroing with light on the sensor corrupts all later readings. Takes a few seconds.
